name: @lwc-bolts/sf-plugin
description: Salesforce CLI plugin that sets up an SFDX project's config files for the lwc-bolts content mapper.

lwc-bolts.description: Lightning Bolts: the content mapper (TypeScript 7) for Lightning Web Components.

project.description: Set up an SFDX project's jsconfig.json or tsconfig.json files for the content mapper, and keep them set up.

options.description: Display and change the content mapper's options in the project config.

managed.description: Cache installed packages' metadata from an org in the project, for the content mapper.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run build -w @lwc-bolts/lightning-base-components -w @lwc-bolts/sf2ts -w @lwc-bolts/sfdx-project -w @lwc-bolts/project-setup -w @lwc-bolts/typescript-content-mapper
